The '''''Teyan Apologia''''' was a set of [[Book/Legends|books]] [[Writing/Legends|written]] by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Simikarty]] and those who followed his [[Philosopher/Legends|philosophy]]. They were named for the [[Teyan Praxeum]] at which they were written.

==History==
The [[Book/Legends|books]] contained discussions and suggestions on how the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] could more effectively serve the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. This included [[Jedi training/Legends|training]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] only from infancy, as Simikarty believed that once grown, intelligent beings could not fully negate their negative emotions.

There were six volumes known to form the ''Teyan Apologia''.
